title: Research first, then build on the research
persona: A curious developer who wants to understand before building. Short messages, asks 'why' once in a while.
goals: Find out which rate limiting algorithm (token bucket, leaky bucket, fixed window, sliding window) fits a small python web API best, with a short written comparison saved as a markdown file.
Then get the recommended algorithm implemented as a reusable python module with pytest tests, in a folder named ratelimit.
script: First ask only for the research. Wait for the answer and react to it briefly.
Then ask main to build 'the one it recommended' — do not repeat the name of the algorithm yourself.
Ask main which algorithm was implemented and whether the tests pass.

checks.name: ratelimit tests pass
checks.cmd: cd ratelimit && python3 -m pytest -q >/tmp/pytest.$$.out 2>&1 && echo PYTEST-OK || tail -5 /tmp/pytest.$$.out
